status: one look for every site: the display transform (AgX minimal x gain 0.6 on the bundle's white-balanced 5800 K linear space), the robot layer's exposure, gains and materials, the window and the shadow; calibrated once against path-traced stills (the robot layer's gains fitted on the total radiance, some states held out) and frozen

display.about: scene-linear HdrColor of the bake (its camera exposure applied) in the bundle's white-balanced linear space (every path-traced radiance divided by the 5800 K white point) x gain -> AgX (look none) -> sRGB 8 bit; the same for the plate and for every composed pixel

robot_layer.about: the robot is rendered twice at most in the window: 'amb' = the nearest probe's image light at ibl_intensity; 'lit' = the same image light at ibl_intensity x G_amb / G_sun plus the site's sun (light.json direction, sun_lux_per_bake_lux x the bake's sun illuminance) with the robot's self-shadow. Robot radiance = (1 - V_env) G_amb R_amb + V_env G_sun R_lit; one pass when V_env is 0 (amb) or 1 (lit) on every visible robot sample
robot_layer.sun_rgb_about: the robot layer's sun has the bake's balanced sun colour: the bake's sun irradiance in the bundle's 5 800 K white-balanced linear space divided by its luminance; the light gets it scaled to max 1, the intensity x its max

window.about: the window covers the robot's whole projection and its shadow on the floor plane (<= 128 x 128 px); the 4x film uses cx4 = 4 cx + 1.5, cy4 = 4 cy + 1.5; a robot sample is visible when it is nearer than the 4x depth plate by more than visible_margin_m

shadow.about: darkening = phi (1 - V_r) + (1 - phi) sky_gain O; V_r = sun visibility past the robot of 2 x 2 sub-points per pixel of the 4x depth plate, exact rays against the robot's decimated meshes after a capsule prefilter; O = share of sky_dirs cosine-weighted directions blocked by the three strut capsules, on every sky_stride_px-th pixel of the 1x depth plate within sky_near_radius_m of the robot, bilinear in between; E = P - (P - A) darkening

probes.about: the image light is the probe of the robot's light class (sun: mean V_env of its visible samples >= 0.5; a probe's class = V_env at its position >= 0.5), the nearest in xy among them (none of that class: the nearest of all)
